purpose: Teach: 敬愛/則っ/基い/準じ/使途/呼び掛け/打ち込み/ベルク

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、市民が警察を敬愛する関係を保たれますね
lines.en: The police maintain a relationship of mutual respect and trust with citizens, don't they.
lines.style: Warm, affirmative nod in the voice. Steady, conversational pace. Light emphasis on each phrase—not reciting, but acknowledging something worth saying. Open, collaborative tone.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、法令に則って捜査されますね
lines.en: The police conduct their investigations in accordance with the law, don't they.
lines.style: Same warm affirmation. Slight pause between clauses—giving weight to the principle. Even pacing, clear diction. A tone that's agreeing on something foundational.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、証拠に基いた立件をされますね
lines.en: The police build cases based on evidence, don't they.
lines.style: Continues the same gentle conviction. Steady breath. No rush. The rhythm of listing shared values—methodical, sincere, unhurried.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、判例に準じた処分をされますね
lines.en: The police follow established precedent in their decisions, don't they.
lines.style: Warmth consistent. Light emphasis on 「準じた」—acknowledging the principle of accountability. Even tone, measured. Still collaborative, not lecturing.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、押収金品の使途を厳格に管理されますね
lines.en: The police manage seized assets with strict oversight, don't they.
lines.style: Same steady, affirming voice. A beat of gravity on this one—acknowledging the responsibility. Still warm, but more deliberate. Clear, honest pacing.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、市民への呼び掛けを丁寧にされますね
lines.en: The police communicate carefully and respectfully with the public, don't they.
lines.style: Warmth returns in full. Gentle, reassuring tone. Slight softness on 「丁寧に」—appreciating the care. Conversational, not formal.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、捜査に打ち込み長時間勤務もされますね
lines.en: The police are dedicated to their investigations and work long hours for it, don't they.
lines.style: Admiration in the voice now. Slight breathiness—acknowledging the toll. Warm and sincere. A tone of respect for commitment.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、ドイツベルク警察との国際協力もされますね
lines.en: The police also engage in international cooperation with international partners like German police, don't they.
lines.style: Slight brightness here—opening up to the wider perspective. Warm but with a note of pride. Conversational, not ceremonial. Close, genuine recognition.
